articles.title: Airbus Said to Beat 2025 Annual Delivery Goal of 790 Aircraft
articles.mainIdea: Airbus Said to Beat 2025 Annual Delivery Goal of 790 Aircraft
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Airbus Said to Beat 2025 Annual Delivery Goal of 790 Aircraft. Airbus cut its previous 2025 guidance of about 820 handovers last month after a series of glitches involving its best-selling A320 model, including a massive recall for a software upgrade, followed by the discovery of fuselage panels on the same plane model that didn’t meet specifications and require extra inspections. An Airbus spokesperson declined to comment on its annual deliveries, adding that audited orders and delivery figures will be published after markets close on Jan 12. Aircraft deliveries at both Airbus and rival Boeing Co. are closely watched performance measures because they are the biggest source of cash and provide an indicator of supply network stability. Related tickers mentioned: EADSF.
